import json, hashlib
from unittest.mock import patch
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from yoyo.evaluation import spike_burst_v3_density_rearm_gate as gate

totals=dict(seeds=16,bars=0,parents=0,children=0,rearms=0,blocked=0,prefix_checks=0,future_edit_checks=0)
keys=['early','confirmed','candidate_edge','cooldown_blocked','structure_blocked','quota_armed','rearmed',
      'density_valid','density_known_false','density_is_dense','structure_owner_i','parent_i','last_accepted_i']
for seed in range(16):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);n=210
 clock=pd.date_range('2026-01-01',periods=n,freq='h',tz='UTC')
 clock=clock+pd.to_timedelta(np.where(np.arange(n)>=137,2,0),unit='h')
 width=rng.uniform(.5,2,n);flips=rng.uniform(.1,.8,n)
 width[rng.choice(np.arange(25,n),3,replace=False)]=np.nan
 ready=np.ones(n,dtype=bool);ready[rng.choice(np.arange(20,n),4,replace=False)]=False
 summary=np.where((np.arange(n)//17)%2,4.,1.);summary[rng.choice(np.arange(20,n),3,replace=False)]=np.nan
 cross=np.full(n,3.);cross[rng.choice(np.arange(20,n),2,replace=False)]=np.nan
 frame=pd.DataFrame(dict(width=width,flips=flips,pastWidth=summary,pastCrosses=cross,ready=ready,
                        close=100.+np.arange(n)*.01),index=clock)
 seg=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.diff(clock.asi8)!=pd.Timedelta(hours=1).value)]
 local=np.arange(n)-np.maximum.accumulate(np.r_[0,np.where(np.diff(seg)!=0,np.arange(1,n),0)])
 condition=(rng.random(n)<.42)&ready&(local>=12)
 dense=ready&(summary<=3)&(cross>=2)&(local>=12)
 fields=pd.DataFrame(dict(early_condition=condition,prog_dense=dense,
     prog_prior_high=frame.close-.005,prog_prior_low=frame.close-1.,
     tag_recent_density=rng.random(n)<.7,tag_advance=rng.random(n)<.6,tag_volume=rng.random(n)<.6,
     tag_md_ge_signal=rng.random(n)<.7,tag_middle_rising=rng.random(n)<.8),index=clock)
 expected=[];armed=True;owner=None;seen=False;last=None;previous=False;parent=None;sent=False;parenthigh=np.nan;start=0
 for i in range(n):
  if i and clock[i]-clock[i-1]!=pd.Timedelta(hours=1):
   armed=True;owner=None;seen=False;last=None;previous=False;parent=None;sent=False;parenthigh=np.nan;start=i
  valid=bool(i-start>=12 and ready[i] and np.isfinite([summary[i],cross[i]]).all()
         and np.isfinite(frame[['width','flips']].iloc[i-12:i].to_numpy()).all())
  isdense=bool(valid and summary[i]<=3 and cross[i]>=2)
  knownfalse=valid and not isdense;rearmed=False
  if owner is not None and not armed:
   if i>owner and knownfalse:seen=True
   if seen and isdense and i-12>owner:armed=True;rearmed=True
  edge=bool(condition[i] and not previous);cool=last is None or i-last>=12
  early=bool(edge and cool and armed);blocked=bool(edge and cool and not armed)
  if early:
   owner=last=parent=i;parenthigh=float(fields.prog_prior_high.iloc[i]);armed=False;seen=False;sent=False
  if parent is not None and i-parent>3:parent=None;parenthigh=np.nan;sent=False
  f=fields.iloc[i]
  child=bool(parent is not None and not sent and ready[i] and frame.close.iloc[i]>parenthigh
       and f.tag_recent_density and f.tag_advance and f.tag_volume and f.tag_md_ge_signal and f.tag_middle_rising)
  if child:sent=True
  expected.append(dict(early=early,confirmed=child,candidate_edge=edge,cooldown_blocked=bool(edge and not cool),
     structure_blocked=blocked,quota_armed=bool(armed),rearmed=rearmed,density_valid=valid,
     density_known_false=knownfalse,density_is_dense=isdense,
     structure_owner_i=float(owner) if owner is not None else np.nan,
     parent_i=float(parent) if parent is not None else np.nan,last_accepted_i=float(last) if last is not None else np.nan))
  previous=bool(condition[i])
 with patch.object(gate,'early_fields',side_effect=lambda f:fields.loc[f.index].copy()):
  actual=gate.detect(frame)
  pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual[keys],pd.DataFrame(expected,index=clock)[keys])
  for stop in [1,12,13,30,43,80,137,138,149,150,209]:
   pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(gate.detect(frame.iloc[:stop]),actual.iloc[:stop]);totals['prefix_checks']+=1
  modified=frame.copy();modified.iloc[160:,modified.columns.get_indexer(['width','flips','pastWidth','pastCrosses','close'])]=999.
  pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(gate.detect(modified).iloc[:160],actual.iloc[:160]);totals['future_edit_checks']+=1
 totals['bars']+=n
 for target,col in [('parents','early'),('children','confirmed'),('rearms','rearmed'),('blocked','structure_blocked')]:totals[target]+=int(actual[col].sum())
print(json.dumps(dict(status='passed',scope='Independent scalar quota oracle over synthetic original-field snapshots; no market files or scoring',checks=totals)))

import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from yoyo.evaluation import spike_burst_replay as base
from yoyo.evaluation import spike_burst_v3_density_rearm_gate as gate
totals=dict(seeds=5,bars=0,parents=0,children=0,prefix_checks=0,future_ohlcv_edits=0)
for seed in range(5):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed+501);n=760
 c=100+np.cumsum(rng.normal(.01,.16,n))+2*np.sin(np.arange(n)/19)
 o=np.r_[c[0],c[:-1]]
 raw=pd.DataFrame(dict(open=o,high=np.maximum(o,c)+rng.uniform(.02,.3,n),
     low=np.minimum(o,c)-rng.uniform(.02,.3,n),close=c,volume=rng.lognormal(5,1,n)),
     index=pd.date_range('2024-01-01',periods=n,freq='h',tz='UTC'))
 full=gate.detect(base.features(raw))
 for stop in (340,341,360,430,500,600,759):
  prefix=gate.detect(base.features(raw.iloc[:stop]))
  pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(prefix,full.iloc[:stop]);totals['prefix_checks']+=1
 changed=raw.copy();changed.iloc[610:]=raw.iloc[610:]*3
 pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(gate.detect(base.features(changed)).iloc[:610],full.iloc[:610]);totals['future_ohlcv_edits']+=1
 totals['bars']+=n;totals['parents']+=int(full.early.sum());totals['children']+=int(full.confirmed.sum())
print(json.dumps(dict(status='passed',scope='Entire original feature stack from generated OHLCV only; no stored market inputs',checks=totals)))
